pages.title: Permanent Links
pages.text: While books can be used from the hand, establishing a permanent gateway requires a Crystal Portal. $(br)$(br)Build an enclosed frame out of $(c)Crystal Blocks$(). The frame can be vertical or horizontal and can use a range of shapes as long as the structure closes properly.

pages.title: Ignition
pages.text: One block of the frame must be a $(c)Book Receptacle$(). Once the frame is sealed, place a valid Linking Book or Descriptive Book into the receptacle. If the frame is valid, the portal ignites instantly and inherits the linked Age's visual identity.
Removing the book from the receptacle, or breaking any crystal block in the frame, severs the connection immediately.
